title: The Morning Circuit — Sunday, June 07, 2026
description: Top stories: Hacked, leaked, and held for ransom: the worst breaches of 2026 so far; How to get your money's worth from YouTube Premium; School shooting survivor sues AI gun detection firm after system failed to spot weapon; US states are reportedly planning to sue to block Paramount's Warner Bros. takeover; Scientists ejected from diabetes conference for distributing journal reprints.
